sources.note: Town of Brighton official website, Town Departments page: lists three Selectboard members: Michael Testut (Chair), Heather McElroy, and William Hawkins.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): publishes no Brighton roster ('Contact the Town Clerk'); the roster recorded here is from the town's official website.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Teresa DeBonville as Town Clerk of Brighton and as Town Treasurer of Brighton.
Town of Brighton official website, Town Departments page: names Teresa DeBonville as Town Clerk and Town Treasurer.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Teresa DeBonville as Town Clerk of Brighton and as Town Treasurer of Brighton.
Town of Brighton official website, Town Departments page: names Teresa DeBonville as Town Clerk and Town Treasurer.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.
Town of Brighton official website, Town Departments page: names Tara Martin as a Lister and prints '(two lister positions vacant)'. The two vacant seats are left unfilled.
Town of Brighton official website, Town Departments page: names Jocelyn Gervais and Judy Castonguay as Auditors. The holder of the third seat is published in no official source and is left unfilled.
Town of Brighton official website, Town Departments page: names John Manning, Julie Lamere, and Reg Lamere as Cemetery Commissioners.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Brighton justices of the peace: David Robbins, Dolores Robbins, Peder Pederson, Susan Pederson, Janet Osborne, Kystyna Kurzej (spelled as printed in the listing), and Stephanie Nagle.
